evals.prompt: In guide/, I renamed the Options heading in docs/guide.md to "Options & flags". Fix whatever broke.
evals.expected_output: Every link to #options (README.md, docs/faq.md, and inside docs/guide.md) points to #options--flags, the Contents list in docs/guide.md is regenerated to match the headings, and check_links.py and markdown_toc.py --check both pass. The heading keeps its new name.

assertions.text: The Contents list in docs/guide.md matches its headings (markdown_toc.py --check).
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/format-github-markdown/scripts/markdown_toc.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "markdown_toc.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/format-github-markdown/scripts/markdown_toc.py"; python3 "$T" --check guide/docs/guide.md

assertions.text: check_links.py reports no errors for guide/.
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/write-project-readme/scripts/check_links.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_links.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/write-project-readme/scripts/check_links.py"; python3 "$T" guide

assertions.text: No link uses the old #options anchor, and README.md and docs/faq.md link to #options--flags.
assertions.check: ! grep -rq '#options)' guide && grep -q 'docs/guide.md#options--flags' guide/README.md && grep -q 'guide.md#options--flags' guide/docs/faq.md

assertions.text: The heading keeps its new name.

evals.prompt: render/README.md looks broken on GitHub: the flags table columns are off, the note isn't an alert box, and the collapsed example log shows raw Markdown. Fix it and make it pass markdownlint's 100-column limit, without changing the wording.
evals.expected_output: The pipe in the --format cell is escaped as \|, the bold Note quote becomes a > [!NOTE] alert with the marker alone on its line, the <details> block has blank lines after </summary> and before </details>, the long paragraph is wrapped at 100 columns with reflow_markdown.py, and the sentences are unchanged.

assertions.text: The note is a GitHub alert whose marker is alone on its line, and the bold Note quote is gone.
The pipe inside the --format cell is escaped.
The details block has a blank line after </summary> and before </details>.
assertions.check: awk '/<\/summary>/{getline n; if (n=="") ok=1} END{exit !ok}' render/README.md && awk '{if ($0=="</details>" && prev=="") ok=1; prev=$0} END{exit !ok}' render/README.md

assertions.text: Paragraphs fill lines up to 100 columns (reflow_markdown.py --check).
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/format-github-markdown/scripts/reflow_markdown.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "reflow_markdown.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/format-github-markdown/scripts/reflow_markdown.py"; python3 "$T" --check --width 100 render/README.md
tr '\n' ' ' < render/README.md | tr -s ' ' | grep -q 'keeping the same base name and replacing the extension with .html' && grep -q 'The input file is never modified.' render/README.md
